en.hubeali:
Some of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, and frm Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar, altogether, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Abdul Muttalibasws would be Resurrected (on the Day of Judgment) as one community. Upon himas would be the glory of the kings and a mark of the Prophetsas, and that is because heasws was the first one to say (believe) in Al-Bada’a (Change of Allahazwj’s Decision’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And it was so that Abdul Muttalib<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> sent Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> to his<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> shepherds among camels which had spread out. So he<sup>saww</sup> gathered them, but was delayed upon it. So he<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> grabbed the ring of the Door of the Kabah and went on saying: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! Will You<sup>azwj</sup> Destroy Your Sign? If You<sup>azwj</sup> do so, it would be a matter what is Changed for You<sup>azwj</sup>’.

So Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> came over with the camels, and Abdul Muttalib<sup>as</sup> had looked for him<sup>saww</sup> in every road and in every cave seeking him<sup>saww</sup>, and went on shouting: ‘O Lord<sup>azwj</sup>! Will You<sup>azwj</sup> destroy Your<sup>azwj</sup> Sign? If You<sup>azwj</sup> do so, it would be a matter what is Changed for You<sup>azwj</sup>’. When he<sup>as</sup> saw Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, he<sup>as</sup> grabbed him<sup>saww</sup>, and kissed him<sup>as</sup>, and said: ‘O my<sup>as</sup> son<sup>saww</sup>! I<sup>as</sup> will not divert you<sup>saww</sup> after this with regards to anything, for I<sup>as</sup><sup>ws</sup> fear that you<sup>saww</sup> might be assassinated, murdered’.
en.sarwar: 23. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Abdallah ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman al-’Asamm from al-Hatham ibn Waqid from Muqarrin from abu ‘‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“ ‘Abd al-Muttalib is the first one who believer in Bada’ (Allah’s revised will). He will be resurrected as a whole nation. He will have a august presence like kings and an countenance like the prophets.”
